items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: Certainly Ace Watson Wore the Reversible Sash of Office... But I don't Remember anything Quite like that With parades

ctx.x: Those kind of The grand marshal Never Cut up in the way This Or carried on They had a certain Sense of dignity They might be A trickster Do you remember The grand marshal Making their turn

I don't Remem This is something That you would know More about than I I remember Grand marshal At funerals I do not remember them Particularly At parades At parades What I thought I saw Was Was a Particular functionary Of the organization Being dressed In A More Obviously Magnificent Uniform Than the others But not A grand marshal As such And I don't Know whether That was Something That was Reserved For funerals Or not Certainly Ace Watson Wore the Reversible Sash of Office With the I believe Purple With gold…
Well the brighter One would have Been for Coming back
